Amazon Prime Air is the company's drone delivery service, and today announced a significant expansion of its coverage. By the end of 2026, it is expected to cover nearly 500 US cities. Below are the locations where Amazon drone delivery will be launching next.

Amazon Prime Air will cover nearly 500 US cities by the end of 2026

Amazon's Prime Air service is expanding rapidly, with plans to cover nearly 500 cities and towns across the United States by the end of 2026 — a sixfold increase from its current scale — bringing ultra-fast drone delivery to tens of millions of customers nationwide. Prime Air offers the most comprehensive selection of drone-deliverable items, including millions of groceries, electronics, beauty products, medications, and household essentials, all sold at everyday low prices and delivered in as little as 30 minutes.

Prime Air is currently available in the following areas:

  • Tolleson, Arizona (Phoenix metropolitan area)
  • Ruskin, Florida (Tampa metropolitan area)
  • Kansas City, Kansas
  • Papillion, Nebraska (Omaha metropolitan area)
  • Baton Rouge, Louisiana
  • Hazel Park, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Pontiac, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Richmond, Texas (Houston metropolitan area)
  • San Antonio, Texas
  • Richardson, Texas (Dallas metropolitan area)
  • Waco, Texas

Drone delivery will gradually launch in the following metropolitan areas: Chicago, Illinois; Syracuse, New York; Cleveland, Ohio; Atlanta, Georgia; and Boise, Idaho. Amazon added: "More communities will be joining later."

Prime members can enjoy free drone delivery on orders of $50 or more. Orders under $50 require a $2.99 delivery fee, while non-Prime members using drone delivery will be charged $4.99.

Is Amazon drone delivery already available in your area? How was your experience? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
